description: Relación de entidades locales de Castilla-La Mancha con Agrupación de Voluntarios de Protección Civil is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Autónoma de Castilla-La Mancha. It contains the contact details of the groups of civil protection volunteers registered in the Registry of Civil Protection Groups and Volunteers of Castilla-La Mancha. Coverage: Comunidad Autónoma de Castilla-La Mancha. The portal shows the English title as "List of local entities in Castile-La Mancha with the Civil Protection Volunteers Group" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Comunidad Autónoma de Castilla-La Mancha. Its keywords include Entidades locales, Protección civil, Agrupaciones voluntarios. The listing shows 6 download or service links in SHEET, CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2026-03-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/es/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
